standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness of a fibre product of modules over a fibre product of rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives finiteness over the quotient ring.

core_obligations: Recall the surjection from the fibre product ring onto the fibre product of the two rings (proof lines 1048-1049).
Observe that the constructed module lives over that quotient (proof lines 1050-1051).
Apply the finiteness criterion over the quotient (proof lines 1051-1054).
Conclude finiteness over the fibre product ring (proof lines 1055-1056).
proof_roadmap: The surjection onto the fibre product of rings (proof lines 1048-1049).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibre product of a finite module over one ring and a finite module over another, matched over a common quotient, is finite over the fibre product ring whenever each ingredient is finite over its own ring. The proof recalls that the structure map from the fibre product ring onto the fibre product of the two rings is surjective, observes that the constructed module is naturally a module over that surjective quotient, applies the earlier finiteness criterion for fibre products of rings to conclude finiteness over the quotient, and then descends finiteness along the surjection.
